string.name: what_s_new_latest
string.font:
🌟 UI Enhancements: Redesigned Shortcut components with gradient borders and native SVG support. 
🌟 Nearby Share Fix: Resolved target component issues for more reliable sharing. 
🌟 System Requirements: Minimum requirement updated to Android 10 (API 29) for improved security and performance. 
🌟 Biometrics: Streamlined authentication flow for modern Android versions. 
🌟 Under the Hood: Major dependency updates including Java 17, Gradle 9, and Compose optimizations.
